_help: The MENU window (UI/UITotalMenu.img/main art). x/y = the window spot in 1366x768 game pixels, w/h = the window size. The art is 1022x698: the white body ends at y=576 (577 is the shadow's edge line), the shadow runs to y=596, then 14 empty rows, then the official quick menu strip (the editor of the icon row) from y=611. We do not show that strip, so h stops at 597; h must never pass the art's own height (698) or the draw samples past the texture. titleH = the strip above the tabs that drags the window. col0X..col6X = the seven column spots (the blue tabs), col0Rows..col6Rows = how many menu items the column has. row0Y..row8Y = the item row spots. bot0X..bot6X/botY = the bottom row of seven buttons (their WZ origins are the negative of these spots). closeX/closeY = the X button. badgeX/badgeY = the key badge at the right of a row (the official vector:key spot). chInfoX/chInfoY = the channel name in the pill at the top right.
